$comment: Catalog v4 (2026-07-30, per Bri + playtest-7) — 4 stores x 3 items, all 12 prices globally unique so any revealed amount identifies the item. Design law: every effect is ONE clause and references only core rules (vote, night attack, sightings, morning report) — never another item. No pure covers: cheap items carry small real purposes; deniability comes from hidden amounts, not dead items. class: V/W/B (villager/werebear/both) x off/def/info. Economy: 50 XLM buy-in, +15 XLM/day.

items.label: Horseshoe nail
items.effect: Lucky iron: if the vote ties on you, luck excuses you — you reveal nothing. One nail, one escape.

items.label: Bear trap
items.effect: If you are eaten, the beast bleeds: it cannot kill the next night.

items.label: Silver charm
items.flavor: Grandmother swore by it. Grandmother is dead.
items.effect: Survive one night attack. The charm shatters, everyone hears it, and you spend the next day in bed — too weak to vote. The werebear cannot buy silver.

general_store.label: General Store
general_store.subtitle: Everything you need. Nothing you can explain.

items.label: A bottle
items.effect: Loose lips: tomorrow's morning report carries one true rumor about the day's shopping. You don't choose which.

items.label: The ledger book
items.flavor: Somebody has to keep the books.
items.effect: Tax records: at dawn, Maude names who spent the most today. Names only — amounts stay sealed.

items.label: Musk salve
items.effect: Shop unseen: tomorrow the sightings log your store visits as a hooded figure instead of your name. Anyone may buy it. Anyone.

items.label: Soup bone
items.flavor: The dogs will love you for it.
items.effect: The dogs remember: at dawn, you privately learn whether the beast came to YOUR door last night — even on a quiet night.

items.label: Smoked ham
items.flavor: Feeds a family. Or something larger.
items.effect: A well-fed bear leaves quietly: if the night attack fails, the morning says nothing at all.

items.label: The butcher's knife
items.effect: Conviction, sharpened: once bought, your vote counts twice for the rest of the game. Everyone hears a knife being ground; nobody knows whose.

items.label: Votive candle
items.flavor: Cheap light for a dark week.
items.effect: If you die, your candle gutters last: Maude posts your final words to the square.

items.label: Lantern oil
items.flavor: Gerald's lantern was still lit, you know.
items.effect: Posthumous: if you are eaten, Maude reads one true fact about the werebear's purchases by your still-lit lantern.

items.label: Unsealing ritual
items.flavor: The Order charges for the truth.
items.effect: At dawn, Maude unseals ONE purchase of the day's most-accused villager and names the item. The vote picks the target; the ritual pays for the reading.
